# UI Design Specification: Lemon & Ardent Adventure Store

## Overview
A minimalist e-commerce homepage for outdoor/adventure gear with a focus on visual storytelling and clean navigation.

## Layout Structure
- **Full-viewport height hero section** with fixed navigation bar
- **Header**: 80px height, dark blue background
- **Hero**: 100vh height, split layout with text on left, image on right
- **Content**: Centered text block with call-to-action button

## Color Palette
- **Header Background**: `#2C3E50` (dark slate blue)
- **Hero Background**: `#A8C5D6` (light blue-gray)
- **Primary Text**: `#2C3E50` (dark slate blue)
- **Secondary Text**: `#34495E` (slate blue)
- **Button Background**: `#F7DC6F` (yellow)
- **Button Text**: `#2C3E50` (dark slate blue)
- **Icon Colors**: `#ECF0F1` (light gray)

## Typography
- **Logo/Brand**: "Lemon & Ardent" - **Montserrat** (sans-serif), 18px, 500 weight
- **Navigation**: "Shop All", "About", etc. - **Montserrat**, 16px, 400 weight
- **Hero Heading**: "Adventure Awaits" - **Montserrat**, 80px, 700 weight
- **Subheading**: "Equip for Exciting Journeys" - **Montserrat**, 20px, 400 weight
- **Button Text**: "Shop Now" - **Montserrat**, 18px, 600 weight

## Spacing & Layout
- **Header Padding**: 0 40px (horizontal)
- **Header Vertical Spacing**: 24px (logo to nav, nav to login)
- **Hero Text Padding**: 80px left, 40px top
- **Hero Text Margin**: 0 0 24px 0 (between heading and subheading)
- **Button Padding**: 16px 40px (horizontal/vertical)
- **Button Margin**: 40px top from subheading

## Navigation
- **Logo**: Left-aligned, 32px width, 24px height
- **Navigation Links**: Center-aligned, 32px horizontal spacing
- **Login/Cart**: Right-aligned, 32px horizontal spacing
- **Login Icon**: 24px diameter circle, 2px border
- **Cart Icon**: 24px height, 2px stroke

## Interactive Elements
- **Navigation Links**: Hover state: `#3498DB` (blue), underline
- **Login Button**: Hover state: `#ECF0F1` (light gray) background
- **Cart Icon**: Hover state: `#E74C3C` (red) for items count
- **Shop Now Button**: Hover state: `#F39C12` (orange) background, cursor: pointer

## Visual Hierarchy
1. **Hero Heading** (80px, 700 weight) - Most prominent
2. **Navigation** (16px, 400 weight) - Secondary
3. **Subheading** (20px, 400 weight) - Tertiary
4. **Button** (18px, 600 weight) - Action-focused
5. **Login/Cart** (16px, 400 weight) - Least prominent

## Design Tokens
- **Border Radius**: 30px (button), 50% (login icon)
- **Box Shadow**: None (flat design)
- **Transition**: 0.3s ease (all interactive elements)
- **Line Height**: 1.2 (headings), 1.5 (body text)

## Images
- **Hero Image**: Right-aligned, 60% width, cover positioning
- **Model**: Wearing brown puffer jacket with backpack
- **Background**: Light blue sky gradient

## Responsive Considerations
- **Mobile**: Hero text stacks vertically, navigation becomes hamburger menu
- **Tablet**: Hero heading reduces to 60px, button padding decreases
- **Desktop**: Current layout preserved

## Accessibility
- **Contrast**: All text meets WCAG 2.1 AA standards
- **Focus States**: Visible outline on all interactive elements
- **Alt Text**: "Model wearing adventure gear against blue sky background" for hero image

This design emphasizes clean typography, strategic color contrast, and intuitive navigation to create an engaging shopping experience for outdoor enthusiasts.
